name: Denial of Service
description: Denial-of-Service attacks flood a target system with excessive traffic, causing service disruption and preventing legitimate access.

feature_explanation.src_bytes: Large volume of data sent from source indicates flooding behavior.
feature_explanation.count: High number of connections suggests repeated requests to overwhelm the system.
feature_explanation.serror_rate: High SYN error rate indicates incomplete TCP handshakes typical in DoS attacks.

name: Distributed Denial of Service
description: Distributed DoS attacks originate from multiple sources targeting a single system, overwhelming it with massive traffic.

feature_explanation.dst_host_count: Large number of connections to a single host indicates coordinated attack.
feature_explanation.src_bytes: High incoming data volume suggests traffic flooding.

name: Network Scanning
description: Probe attacks scan networks to discover open ports and services, often as a precursor to further attacks.

feature_explanation.diff_srv_rate: Connections to multiple services indicate scanning behavior.
feature_explanation.srv_diff_host_rate: Connections to multiple hosts suggest reconnaissance activity.

name: Port Scanning
description: Port scanning involves probing multiple ports on a host to identify open services.

feature_explanation.dst_host_count: Multiple connection attempts to the same host.

name: Remote to Local Attack
description: R2L attacks attempt unauthorized access to a system from a remote machine.

feature_explanation.num_failed_logins: Repeated login failures indicate brute-force attempts.
feature_explanation.logged_in: Failed authentication attempts signal intrusion attempts.

name: Brute Force Login
description: Brute force attacks attempt multiple password combinations to gain unauthorized access.

feature_explanation.num_failed_logins: Multiple failed login attempts indicate password guessing.
feature_explanation.logged_in: Failure to log in confirms unsuccessful authentication attempts.

name: User to Root
description: U2R attacks escalate privileges after gaining initial access.

feature_explanation.root_shell: Root shell access indicates privilege escalation.

name: Normal Traffic
description: Normal network traffic follows expected patterns with low error rates and consistent behavior.

feature_explanation.serror_rate: Low error rates indicate healthy connections.
feature_explanation.count: Moderate connection counts indicate normal usage.
